why: Rule v1 passed its in-match test (rule-v1/test-learned.json) but its mirror bouts were unwatchable: ~33% clinch, body hooks dominant, hooks/uppercuts ~0, knockdowns 0.7%. claim: In-match learning is claimed only if the paired bootstrap 95% interval of (learning - frozen) point margin over the learned opponents has a lower bound above 0.
secondary: MaleCNS vs shuffled-graph control; superiority only if lower bound > 0
